sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:30 – 14:30)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 5 sets of keys, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 1 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Debrief completed with Night Shift regarding the early-morning status of the CBD; suited up and ready for deployment.
Commencing Alpha Route. Check-in at corner of Victoria Street East and Queen Street, all clear. Heavy construction along the footpath on Victoria Street East.
Welfare check at Lotus Foreign Exchange, Nike Store, Cotton On, Habits Vietnamese Cafe and Eatery, Localito Convenience Store, all clear.
Check-in at Skyworld Entertainment Centre, all clear.
Welfare check on Wellesley Street East: Haus of Gelato, Dum Dum Dumplings, EIKBEN by Mark'ne Limited, Remedy Coffee, Father Teds, all clear.
Welfare check at Elliott Stables, Elliott Street Apartment, Atrium on Elliott, Elliott Food Court, all clear.
Standing by to show presence to morning commuters and foot traffic coming through from Aotea train station.
Welfare check and walkthrough of Elliott Street, all clear:
Welfare check at Woolworths Victoria Street West, Kiwi Gift, Mr Katsu, City Liquor, Cinnamon Squared, Sana, Scrunchy Miller's, all clear.
Welfare check at Albert Mart Convenience Store, Discount Dairy and Vape Shop, Nola Coffee, Ichiiban Japanese Restaurant, all clear.
Welfare check at Zibbetto Espresso Bar, Palmer Bar, Ronnies Cafe, Woolworths Lower Albert Street, Aotea Gifts, all clear.
Walkthrough of Commercial Bay, welfare through the mall, all clear.
Check-in at Commercial Bay, full sweep around the square, all clear.
Standing by to show presence to morning commuters and the public before moving to the next checkpoint.
Response call from Tribe regarding a male individual of concern outside the premises showing signs of being under the influence of narcotics; assistance requested to check on him.

Arrived at the response call; spoke to the individual, who appears to be under the influence and not fully coherent. Manager wants him moved along, but he claims it is a public footpath and is refusing to move. Standing by until he leaves and management feels safe.
Still standing by until the individual leaves; still in front of the Tribe hotel footpath.
Still standing by until the individual leaves; still in front of the Tribe hotel footpath.
Still standing by until the individual leaves; still in front of the Tribe hotel footpath.

Continued verbally asking the individual to move along; he eventually moved to the side of the building but is likely to return to the front entrance of Tribe, so we will continue standing by until he leaves the surrounding area completely.
Individual tried to return; we made clear on management's behalf that the outside area of the hotel/restaurant is licensed and they would like him to leave their permitted area.
Individual has finally left the area. Returning to routes. Ending Alpha Route and commencing Beta + Delta Route.
Check-in at Giapo, Gore Street, all clear.
Welfare check and sweep through Wilson Carpark, Fort Street, all clear.
Welfare check on stores along lower High Street towards Lorne Street, all clear:
Welfare check at Coco Lane, all clear:
Welfare check on stores along Lorne Street, all clear:
Check-in at corner of Wellesley Street East and Lorne Street, all clear.
Walkthrough of Auckland Library, all clear.
Welfare check at Choolaah, Dosa Corner, Sushi Pac, all clear.
Check-in at corner of Rutland Street and Wakefield Street, all clear.

Response call during welfare check from Nike — a male individual in black left the shop and set off the sensor; unclear if he stole anything, last seen heading towards Victoria Street West. Assistance requested to retrieve any items taken.
Arrived at the response call; staff will try to retrieve a photo while we scan the nearby areas in case he is still around.

Searched to the corner of Elliott Street and Victoria Street West, no sign of the individual. Response call from McDonald's Queen Street regarding two individuals in-store causing a disturbance; assistance requested to move them along.

Arrived at the response call; staff said they left, just unsatisfied and loud, and thanked us for coming. Standing by to show presence on Queen Street while awaiting calls, as the last two came from the main strip.
Still standing by to show presence.
Response call from Ippondo regarding a vagrant in front of the store; assistance requested to move her along.
Arrived at the response call; she was sitting down and complied when asked to vacate the area.
Making our way to conduct a welfare check on City Liquor due to the high hit-rate at this store.
Heading back down to conduct an interview with a male individual applying for ASG.
Arrived back at Headquarters; standing by awaiting the interviewee.
Conducting interview while remaining vigilant for response calls.
Response call from The Pacifica — individual under the influence inside the cafe next door; assistance requested to move him along.
Arrived at the response call; the individual had already left. Grabbed footage from staff and will keep a lookout. (Footage on file.)
Response call from Mirrou regarding an individual who stole items, last seen heading up Queen Street; assistance requested to retrieve the items.
Arrived at the response call and swept towards upper Queen Street.
No sign of the female after the sweep. Photo of the stolen items provided by staff. (Photo on file.)
Standing by to show presence to the public before continuing patrols.
Welfare check at Footlocker, Cosmetic Clinic, Sale Shop, Fun Tech, Avachi, Hulucat, Chacha Panda, Bahn-Mi King, Subway, 77 Convenience Store, all clear.
Check-in at Aotea Square, all clear.
Check-in at Auckland Town Hall, all clear.
Tanuki Japanese Sake and Sushi Bar
Ending Beta + Delta Route and commencing Echo Route.
Check-in at corner of Darby Street and Queen Street, all clear.
Welfare check at Bag Planet, Mobile Planet, Lumi Cafe, Celine Mediterranean Cuisine, Mali Thai, Recycle Boutique, all clear.
Welfare check through Strand Arcade and all stores within the vicinity, all clear.
Welfare check through Mid City Arcade and all businesses within the vicinity, all clear.
Response call from Celine Mediterranean Cuisine regarding vagrants beside the shop who need moving along.
Arrived at the response call and asked the individuals to move along, to which they complied.
Lunch break completed; standing by for changeover to the Afternoon Shift.

Standing by at HQ to charge the Ops Phone, enough to patrol while businesses are still open.
Ops Phone at 30%, enough to patrol while most businesses are still open.

Arrived at Chancery Square / Freyberg Square; welfare check, all clear, nothing to report. Commencing a full sweep of Chancery Square / Freyberg Square:
Full sweep complete, as well as welfare checks on stores at Chancery Square, all clear:
Arrived at Jean Batten Street / Fort Street; welfare check, all clear. Commencing a full sweep of Fort Street down to Gore Street with a Wilson Carpark sweep as well as welfare checks on stores:
Arrived at Gore Street; welfare check, no issues reported. Wilson Carpark sweep complete, no issues:
Arrived at TK Square; welfare check, all clear, no issues. Standing by to maintain presence for the public and surrounding businesses:
Departing standby area; no problematic issues within the area.

Arrived at Pocket Park; standing by for security presence and on the lookout for any issues or vagrants and nearby response calls. Welfare check on stores between TK Square and Pocket Park complete, no issues:
Leaving standby area; no issues within the area.
Arrived at the bottom of Wyndham Street; welfare check complete, no issues. Standing by to maintain security presence:
Leaving standby area; no issues within the area.
Arrived at the bottom of Durham Street East; welfare check complete, no issues. Standing by to maintain security presence:

Response call from the pastor of St Patrick's Cathedral regarding a male vagrant who had been verbally trespassed and has returned to St Patrick's Square; assistance requested to move him along and issue a written trespass.
Arrived at HQ to receive trespass notices; standing by as they are printed by management.
Heading to the St Patrick's Cathedral response call.
Arrived at St Patrick's Square Cathedral; got the trespass notice signed by the property manager.
Trespass notice issued to the male vagrant; standing by as we gave him time to pack up his belongings.
Male has been successfully moved from the premises and issued the trespass notice.
While heading back to HQ, welfare check on City Liquor, all clear, no issues reported.
Standing by at HQ charging the Ops Phone due to low percentage while remaining vigilant for response calls. Percentage displayed on the kitchen camera.
Arrived outside McDonald's Queen Street; welfare check:
Welfare check on the stores above; nothing to report. Maintaining presence outside Mid City on the lookout for any issues or vagrants.
Leaving standby area; no issues have occurred.
Arrived at Aotea Square; welfare check, all clear. Standing by at Aotea Square ensuring presence for the public and on the lookout for issues or vagrants:
Leaving standby area; no issues to report.
Arrived at Mayoral Drive check-in; welfare check at Te Waihorotiu train station, all clear, nothing to report.
Arrived at the corner of Albert Street / Victoria Street West; welfare check, all clear:
Arrived at the top of Victoria Street West; welfare check on stores within the area, all clear. Standing by for security presence and on the lookout for any issues or vagrants.
Leaving standby area; no issues within the area. Heading back to HQ for a 30-minute meal break.
Arrived at HQ for a 30-minute break while remaining vigilant for response calls.
Standing by at HQ awaiting Night Shift for handover while remaining vigilant for response calls.

sections.title: Night Shift (22:30 – 06:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Geared up and ready for patrols.
Welfare checks at 77 Convenience Store, Queen Street McDonald's, Avachi, Banh Mi King, no issues to report.
Police pulled over a Mercedes on Queen Street and searched the car; on standby to provide any assistance.
No assistance needed from police. Heading up to Aotea Square.
Upper Queen Street all clear, no issues to report.
Patrolling Aotea Square, commencing full sweep.
Aotea Square full sweep complete, all clear, no issues and no nearby calls. Heading towards Mayoral Drive.
Mayoral Drive / Wellesley all clear, no issues to report.
Welfare check at 77 Convenience Store Victoria, no issues; a few vagrants outside the store, on standby showing security presence.
77 Convenience Store all clear, no issues to report.
Check-in at St Patrick's Cathedral Church, all clear, no issues.
On standby outside Ace Karaoke Bar showing security presence.
Ace Karaoke all clear, no issues to report. Patrolling down Albert Street.
Welfare check at Albert Street Convenience Store, no issues; a few guys outside 17 Albert Street (apartments), on standby showing presence.
Group has left, all clear, no issues to report.
Albert Street full sweep complete, all clear, no issues to report. Patrolling Quay Street.
Welfare check at Providor / AAS, all clear, no issues.
Responding to a call from Britomart McDonald's due to minors vaping inside. 01:00 arrived on site. 01:06 removed the group of teenagers inside McDonald's.

A fight broke out outside Commercial Bay; we managed to stop them, but they kept talking and continued fighting — females and a male. 01:30 broke up the fight and separated the parties; police now involved and talking to one group. On standby to assist.

Spoke with police about what happened; the other party came back and apparently one of them had a knife (not seen by us, but notified to police by one of them). 02:17 they all got arrested. Commercial Bay all clear, no further issues.
Full sweep of Fort Street / Gore Street / Wilson Carpark; welfare check at Jo and Joes, no issues to report.
Shortland Street all clear, no issues. Heading up Queen Street.
Check-in at Chemist Warehouse / Kathmandu / Wyndham Street, all clear, no issues to report.
Durham Street all clear, no issues.
Welfare check at Queen Street McDonald's, no issues to report. On standby outside Queen Street McDonald's showing presence.
Queen Street McDonald's quietened down, all clear, no issues to report.
Check-in at corner of Lorne Street / Wakefield / Library; just vagrants sleeping outside the library but no issues at this time. Patrolling Lorne Street heading towards High Street.
Lorne Street / High Street all clear, no issues to report.
Check-in at Freyberg / Chancery Square, all clear, no issues to report. Patrolling Kitchener Street.
Kitchener Street all clear, no issues to report. Heading down Wellesley Street.
Wellesley Street all clear, no issues.
Welfare check at Queen Street McDonald's; on standby showing presence and awaiting any nearby calls.
Queen Street McDonald's all clear, no issues to report. Heading back to HQ for a 30-minute break.
Arrived at HQ for a 30-minute break.
Break ended. On standby at HQ charging the Ops Phone (currently at 12%), staying vigilant and ready to respond.
